cards.altText: What if your data kept its address? SPATIAL OMICS Molecules with tissue context. Elegant tissue paper mosaic with localized molecular tokens and a restrained map pin.
cards.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Make ONE finished Instagram carousel card, SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio requested 1080x1080. Full bleed with 80px safe margins. ANGSUMI premium editorial identity: ivory #F7F2E8, maroon #6F2437, forest #304939, sage #94A58B, charcoal. Oversized expressive serif headline; clean readable sans-serif supporting text; generous space, compelling tactile three-dimensional paper scientific metaphor. Brand top ANGSUMI; footer @angsumi.online and supplied card number. Use only EXACT supplied headline and body and explicitly requested tiny conceptual label. No extra handwritten notes, slogans, equations, percentages, fake data, graph values, invented accession IDs or watermarks. Conceptual teaching illustrations, never pretend these are actual analysis results. No collage of several cards: one square card only. Topic spatial-omics. Molecular address atlas: tissue-like paper mosaic, translucent coordinate overlays and specimen map pins; no actual histology dataset. Card 1/6. Headline exact: "What if your data
kept its address?". Body exact: "SPATIAL OMICS
Molecules with tissue context.". Visual: Elegant tissue paper mosaic with localized molecular tokens and a restrained map pin.. Footer number "1/6".
